idea-plugin.name: Gemini Relay
idea-plugin.description:
Deprecated: Gemini Relay is no longer developed. Its successor, AI Relay, takes the same three connection modes — a Vertex deployment behind an Apigee gateway, a Vertex project or a Gemini API key — and also makes that Gemini a model inside GitHub Copilot. Free and open source, like this plugin. Gemini Relay keeps working but gets no further updates.

Gemini Relay — Google Gemini, native in your JetBrains IDE

A native chat panel that brings Google Gemini into IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, Rider and the rest of the JetBrains family — a side-panel coding assistant that talks directly to the Gemini API, to Vertex AI, or to a Vertex deployment behind a custom Apigee gateway, without leaving your IDE or living in the terminal.

Highlights

  • Streaming chat with live tool activity — edits, commands, and file reads as they happen
  • Agent & Ask modes — let Gemini edit and run commands, or keep it strictly read-only
  • Editor-aware — auto-attaches your current selection, so "explain/refactor this" just works
  • Attach files & images — pick a file, or paste a screenshot straight into the prompt (Gemini is multimodal)
  • Searches the web before it answers — release notes, migration guides and real Maven Central coordinates, instead of a version-specific guess from training data
  • MCP tool servers — bring your own tools over the Model Context Protocol
  • Three connection modes — Gemini API key, Vertex AI, or Vertex via Apigee
  • Configurable everything — connection parameters in Settings; secrets in the IDE password safe

Configure the connection under Settings → Tools → Gemini Relay.

☕ Free and open source (MIT). Source, issues, and contributions: github.com/Chelayel/gemini-relay.

Independent and unofficial — not affiliated with Google. Part of the “Relay” family of IDE companions by Chelayel.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.3.3 — No changes to the plugin; the description now shows the panel in IntelliJ IDEA.

1.3.2 — The deprecation notice and the banner above the chat point only to AI Relay.

1.3.1 — No changes to the plugin; the description now shows screenshots of the chat panel.

1.3.0 — Gemini Relay is deprecated in favour of AI Relay, which takes the same Apigee, Vertex or API-key connection and also serves it to GitHub Copilot as a model. A banner at the top of the panel links to it (and to JetBrains Air). Nothing else changes: the panel keeps working, but this is the last release. AI Relay keeps its own settings in ~/.airelay/config.properties; run airelay gemini setup or open its settings page and enter the same gateway values.

1.2.0 — The agent can now check its facts. Three new tools: webSearch, fetchUrl (any page or raw file, as readable text) and mavenSearch (real coordinates and published versions from Maven Central). This closes the gap behind the most common wrong answer — asked about a framework release newer than its training data, the model used to invent plausible artifact ids and configuration properties. Search needs an API key from Brave, Tavily or Google Programmable Search, set under Settings → Tools → Gemini Relay → Web access; reading a URL and looking up Maven Central need no key and work out of the box. Also in this release: a configurable cap on tool rounds per turn, a history trim that no longer drops the original request (or breaks a request by orphaning a tool result), an optional thinking level or budget, and MCP servers that fail to start now say so in the transcript instead of silently contributing nothing. Both new pieces can be checked without spending a turn: Test web access calls each web tool live with the values you've just typed, and Test on an MCP server starts it and lists the tools it advertises (with its stderr, when it dies on startup).

1.1.1 — Cleared the last plugin-verifier warning. The 1.0.8 switch to the two-argument CredentialAttributes constructor still compiled down to the deprecated one, because every Kotlin call site goes through the same defaults bridge; the attributes are now built through the constructor that carries no deprecation. Nothing about the plugin's behaviour changes, and the service name and user name used for the keychain entries are unchanged, so a saved API key or Apigee client secret still loads after the update.

1.1.0 — Current models by default. New chats now use gemini-3.7-flash, Google's current model for coding and agentic work, instead of gemini-2.5-pro, and the suggested list follows the 3.x lineup. The list also matches the connection mode — Vertex names some models differently from the Gemini API, and a selection that has an equivalent id is translated when you switch modes rather than left to fail with a 404. In Gemini API mode the live model list is sorted newest-generation first and no longer offers models this panel can't drive (embeddings, TTS, Live, image and video generation).

1.0.9 — The 1.0.8 fix for SimpleListCellRenderer swapped one scheduled-for-removal overload for another (both static factories are marked for removal). Replaced all 4 call sites with the current textListCellRenderer DSL instead, which carries no deprecation.

1.0.8 — Cleared plugin-verifier warnings: replaced the scheduled-for-removal SimpleListCellRenderer.create(String, Function) overload with its Customizer replacement (4 call sites), and made the credential-attributes lookup use the explicit two-argument constructor.

1.0.6 — Refreshed the model list for Google's current lineup and stopped requests failing on retired models: a saved model Google has shut down (e.g. gemini-3-pro-preview) now auto-migrates to a current default, and the error shown when a model is gone points you to the model selector.

1.0.5 — Restored the rich chat transcript on IntelliJ 2026.2+ (build 262), where JCEF became a separate bundled plugin — the panel now depends on it optionally so the in-browser view works again instead of dropping to plain text. The plain-text fallback also renders at the correct font size when JCEF isn't available.

1.0.3 — Fixed the tool window failing to open on recent IntelliJ builds (NoClassDefFoundError: com/intellij/ui/jcef/JBCefApp): it now degrades to the plain-text transcript instead of failing to initialize.

1.0.0 — First release: native Google Gemini chat panel with streaming transcript & tool activity, Agent & Ask modes, three connection modes (Gemini API, Vertex AI, Vertex via Apigee), editor-aware context, file & image attachments, personas, project memory, and MCP tool servers.
